appName.description: The title of the application, displayed in the web store.

options_plugins_desc.message: Manage extended features and custom modules

plugin_easy_reading_desc.message: Automatically stitch article pages for continuous scrolling, with inline image/video previews and live push updates.

plugin_live_update_desc.message: Periodically refreshes comments while reading posts (e.g. sends 'r' every second), with hotkeys and floating controls.

plugin_anti_idle_desc.message: Periodically sends keepalive signals to the BBS site when idle to prevent disconnects.

plugin_auto_wrap_desc.message: Automatically wrap lines when pasting text longer than the specified limit.

plugin_media_previewer_desc.message: Shows image and media popup preview on hover, supporting Imgur and trusted domain whitelist.

plugin_packet_dump_desc.message: Captures and displays raw WebSocket / Telnet hexadecimal packet streams in real time.

plugin_fps_meter_desc.message: Monitor terminal render framerate (FPS) and render duration in real time, with Canvas/DOM and Smooth ANSI toggles.

plugin_touch_debug_hud_desc.message: On-screen diagnostic HUD tracking mobile touch events, virtual keyboard state, viewport metrics, and one-click diagnostic report copying.

plugin_mouse_browsing_desc.message: Navigate BBS with mouse clicks and wheel scrolling, supporting click to enter boards/articles, text selection, and row highlighting.

plugin_input_helper_desc.message: Visual input palette for ANSI color codes, special symbols, fullwidth punctuation, and emoticons.

plugin_login_assist_desc.message: Prompt login modal to autofill and remember credentials with browser password manager and typeahead into terminal.

plugin_auto_login_desc.message: Prompt login modal to autofill and remember credentials with browser password manager and typeahead into terminal.

login_modal_desc.message: Use browser password manager to autofill or save credentials. Passwords are not saved by the app. Press Cancel to register a new account.

options_picPreviewWhitelistOnly.message: Only preview images from trusted image hosts (Security & Privacy)

options_trustedDomains_empty.message: No trusted image host domains configured.

options_warnBeforeClose.message: Confirm before closing or reloading when connected

options_endTurnsOnLiveUpdate.message: Press END turns on thread live update.

options_lineWrap.message: Wrap line for pasting text longer than

options_colorScheme_default.message: Classic Default (1987 IBM VGA standard 16-color palette)

options_colorScheme_pureBw.message: Pure Black & White (Accessibility monochrome mode, ignores all ANSI colors and background bars)

options_colorScheme_solarizedDark.message: Solarized Dark (Ethan Schoonover's precision lightness-balanced palette, ideal for long reading)

options_colorScheme_nord.message: Nord (Arctic-inspired cool-toned pastel palette with modern minimalist aesthetics)

options_colorScheme_monokai.message: Monokai (Classic Sublime Text theme with warm charcoal background and vibrant contrast)

options_colorScheme_dracula.message: Dracula (Iconic dark purple theme with high-contrast pastel highlights)

options_colorScheme_retroAmber.message: Amber CRT (1970s-80s P3 amber phosphor monochrome CRT monitor, zero blue light for night reading)

options_colorScheme_retroGreen.message: Green CRT (Classic IBM 5151 / Apple II P1 green phosphor monochrome CRT monitor)

options_colorScheme_custom.message: Custom Colors (Customize default background, foreground, hyperlink, and 16-color ANSI palette)

options_colorScheme_customHint.message: Click swatches above to pick custom ANSI colors

options_colorScheme_customizeThis.message: Customize colors based on this theme

options_minimumContrast_desc.message: Automatically adjust foreground brightness to ensure text readability against background (iTerm2 style)

options_fixedTermSize.message: Fixed terminal size (Scale font to fit window, default 80×24)

options_fixedFontSize.message: Fixed font size (Adjust rows and columns by window size)

options_touchFixedFontNote.message: Touch interface uses fixed font size with touch panning

options_fontFitWindowWidth.message: Stretch font to fill the view

options_rightClickAction_paste.message: Paste from clipboard directly (Shift + Right-click opens menu)

options_mouseWheelTrackpadMode_desc.message: Smooth out trackpad scrolling and absorb momentum to prevent over-scrolling. Leave unchecked for standard mouse wheels.

options_mouseWheelChangePost.message: Navigate to previous/next post when scrolling past article boundaries

options_mouseWheelChangePost_desc.message: When reading an article (including Easy Reading mode), scrolling up at the top or down at the bottom after a brief pause navigates to the previous or next post. When disabled, scrolling stops at article boundaries.

options_enableBackNavigation.message: Map browser Back & trackpad left swipe to Left Arrow

options_enableBackNavigation_desc.message: Intercept browser back navigation (trackpad two-finger left swipe, mouse back button) as Left Arrow key instead of leaving the page.

options_mouseWheelAction_arrow1.message: Arrow Up / Down - 1 line (Simulate 1 Up / Down key press)

options_mouseWheelAction_arrow2.message: Arrow Up / Down - 2 lines (Simulate 2 Up / Down key presses)

options_mouseWheelAction_arrow3.message: Arrow Up / Down - 3 lines (Simulate 3 Up / Down key presses)

options_mouseWheelAction_arrow5.message: Arrow Up / Down - 5 lines (Simulate 5 Up / Down key presses)

options_mouseWheelAction_page.message: Page Up / Page Down (Simulate PageUp / PageDown key press)

options_supportMouseReporting_desc.message: Report native mouse and touch pointer/scroll events to the server (Mouse & Touch Reporting). Requires server-side support (e.g., the MOUSE preference option).

about_description.message: Derived from PttChrome, originally by #link_github_iamchucky#. Ported to HTML5 WebSocket by #link_github_robertabcd#. Dual color rendering, dynamic title, version info and CI deployment by #link_github_iid#. Modernization, Canvas rendering and touch interface by #link_github_hungte#. Latest official repository is #link_official_PttTerm# under #link_github_ptt# organization.
